meta.title: KABAD · The exchange platform for African devs
meta.description: Free mentoring, hackathons, app testing, messaging and Africa Rise-Up projects: the exchange platform for devs in Africa and the diaspora. By devs, for devs.

features.title: Five spaces to move forward together

mentoring.name: Mentoring
mentoring.text: Book a free 30-minute session with a mentor badged by KABAD, on a precise problem. The Google Meet link arrives as soon as they accept.

hackathons.name: Hackathons
hackathons.text: Real hackathons created by organisations: online, on site or hybrid. Solo or as a team.

tests.name: App testing
tests.text: Publish your app, gather a group of testers and get precise feedback, with screenshots.

messaging.name: Messages
messaging.text: Invite devs, exchange text, audio, images and files, create your groups.

rise.name: Africa Rise-Up
rise.text: Bring devs from several countries together around projects that answer real African challenges.

audience.title: For every dev, and for those who help them grow

audience.devsText: From the aspiring dev discovering code to the senior who designs systems and leads.
audience.orgsText: Companies, incubators and communities that run hackathons and want to meet talent.

steps.title: Ready in a few minutes

steps.two: Tell us your level and what you are looking for.
steps.three: Invite devs, book a mentor or join a hackathon.
